title: Senior Backend Engineer - Developer Experience & Productivity
description:
About the Role

Taktile helps financial institutions make smarter, safer decisions with the power of AI. Internally, AI coding agents have made writing code dramatically faster. The bottleneck is now everything around the code: builds, tests, reviews, merges, and deploys.

We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer focused on Developer Productivity and Developer Experience to remove that bottleneck. This is a high-leverage, internal engineering role on our Platform Team: your users are Taktile's backend and frontend engineers and the AI agents working alongside them, and your product is the path from first commit to production.

You'll make CI fast and reliable, make our serverless stack easier to build on, and turn "how fast can we ship safely?" into metrics we move every quarter.

What you’ll do

  • Build the deployment services that ship Taktile. Own the systems behind tens of thousands of stack deployments a week across dev, staging, production, and per-customer AWS accounts: progressive rollouts through monitoring and canary stages, deployment windows and gates, and fast rollbacks.

  • Keep our AI developer tooling sharp. Maintain and extend Claudius, our in-house AI engineering agent that investigates CI failures, triages issues, and opens PRs, and metadev, our sandboxed Claude Code and OpenCode setup that packages Taktile's engineering knowledge for every engineer.

  • Own the build → test → merge loop. Drive down CI runtime and flakiness across our main monorepos. Find the slowest and least reliable steps, fix them, and keep them fixed.

  • Evolve our CI/CD architecture. Build on our move to per-module GitHub Actions workflows and a self-hosted runner fleet. Improve caching, parallelism, and cost per build.

  • Shorten the inner dev loop. Make developing on our AWS Lambda stack fast, from running services locally against preview environments to faster, container-based deploys, so engineers aren't waiting on CloudFormation to test a change.

  • Build paved roads. Ship templates, CLIs, and self-service tooling so any team can take a new module from first commit to a running dev workspace in under a day.

  • Design for humans and agents. Make our tooling fast, deterministic, and scriptable so engineers and AI coding agents get quick, trustworthy feedback.

  • Measure what matters. Own DevProd metrics like PR lead time, CI runtime, CI flakiness, and PRs per engineer-day. Use them to decide what to fix next and to prove the impact of what you ship.

  • Own our AI developer tooling. Take ownership of Claudius, our in-house AI engineering agent, and decide where it goes next.

  • Treat engineers as customers. Talk to teams, triage CI incidents, write clear docs, and drive migrations and deprecations to completion.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional backend engineering experience, with a track record of shipping and operating production systems end-to-end and leading technical projects across teams.

  • Strong, production-grade skills in at least one backend language. Python is our main language today, but we're open to others. This role is mostly writing software (tools, services, bots, and CI logic), not only configuring it.

  • Hands-on experience owning CI/CD at scale (for example, GitHub Actions): build and test performance, caching, parallelization, and debugging flaky tests and pipelines.

  • Solid AWS experience, ideally with serverless (Lambda, CloudFormation/SAM) and infrastructure as code (Terraform).

  • Comfortable with the latest AI coding and agent-orchestration tools (for example, Claude Code, OpenCode, subagents, and MCP). You use them daily and know how to make them work reliably for a whole engineering org.

  • A product mindset for internal tooling. You talk to your users, measure outcomes, and judge success by adoption and time saved.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management. You can drive a change across many teams you don't manage: write the proposal, plan the rollout, and see it through.

Ideal, but not required

  • Prior experience on a developer productivity, developer experience, build/release engineering, or platform team.

  • Experience as a product-facing backend engineer, so you know firsthand where the development loop hurts.

  • Experience with frontend build and test tooling in the TypeScript/React ecosystem, so you can support our frontend engineers too.

  • Experience running self-hosted CI runners or build infrastructure at scale.

  • Experience with progressive delivery: canary deployments, automated rollbacks, and deployment gates.

  • Experience with monorepo tooling, build systems, or dependency management at scale.

  • Experience building AI agents or agent infrastructure, such as MCP servers, agent harnesses, or evals.

Our Stack

  • AI: Claude, Claude Code, OpenCode

  • Programming Languages: Python and TypeScript (React) today; open to others where they fit better

  • Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS (Lambda, SAM/CloudFormation, ECR, CodeDeploy), Docker, Terraform

  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions, self-hosted runners

  • Internal Tools: GitHub, Linear, Notion, Metabase

Our Stance

  • We're eager to meet talented and driven candidates regardless of whether they tick all the boxes. We're looking for someone who will add to our culture, not just fit within it. We strongly encourage individuals from groups traditionally underestimated and underrepresented in tech to apply.

  • We seek to actively recognize and combat racism, sexism, ableism and ageism. We embrace and support all gender identities and expressions, and celebrate love in its many forms. We won't inquire about how you identify or if you've experienced discrimination, but if you want to tell your story, we are all ears.

 

About Us

Taktile enables financial institutions to transform into AI-native organizations that are increasingly powered by autonomous agents.

With our modular Agentic Decision Platform, customers combine AI agents, rules, relevant context, and human oversight to safely automate and optimize their decisions—approving more customers, reimbursing claims instantly, stopping fraud before it spreads, and financing every business worth funding.

Founded in 2020, Taktile powers millions of decisions daily for institutions including Mercury, Monzo, Faire, and Pleo.

With offices in New York, Berlin, London, São Paulo, and Iași, the company has raised $184M from Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Index Ventures, Tiger Global, Balderton Capital, and Y Combinator. Learn more at taktile.com.

Zur Einordnung: Ihr Schwerpunkt liegt auf Analytics und Engineering, also auf Datenanbindung, Datenmodellen, Berichten und Governance. Sie setzen selbst um und klären die Anforderungen direkt mit den Fachbereichen. Data Science und Machine Learning spielen in dieser Aufbauphase eine Nebenrolle.

Description

Our quantum sensing technology is already operating in customer environments across United States, Asia and Europe. As our installed base grows and we move from first deployments to repeat orders, ensuring the reliability and performance of every system becomes increasingly important.

As our Global Service Specialist, based at our Munich HQ, you’ll be part of a rapid-deployment team that resolves complex and escalated technical issues across our worldwide installed base. You’ll step in where regional service teams and partners need deeper expertise, and support installations, commissioning, and repairs when situations require it.

You’ll work directly with leading semiconductor foundries, IDMs, and OSATs, ensuring our systems operate reliably and consistently meet their specifications. You’ll collaborate closely with our Engineering and Applications teams, combining technical problem-solving with a strong customer focus.

This is also an opportunity to help shape our global service function from an early stage, introducing the processes, tools, and standards that will support our growing international installed base.

 

Who we are

Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing.

 

Why join QuantumDiamonds?

Picture this:

  • Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide.

  • Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday.

  • Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on.

  • An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you.

Still unsure about why joining us?

  • You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before.

  • From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds.

  • Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years.

  • You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors.

Let’s make the invisible visible!

 
 

What will you do

  • Act as the technical escalation point for regional service teams and distribution partners, resolving issues that require deeper system expertise.

  • Deploy rapidly to customer sites across Europe, the US, and Asia to resolve critical system issues and minimize downtime.

  • Support installation, commissioning, and qualification of our quantum sensing systems when required, working closely with our Munich-based engineering teams.

  • Perform advanced troubleshooting, calibration, and repairs across optical, laser, mechanical, electronic, and software subsystems.

  • Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues systematically, collaborating with Engineering and R&D when root causes go beyond service-level expertise.

What is expected of you

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in field service, service support, or equipment engineering roles, ideally with semiconductor, optical, laser, inspection, or metrology equipment.

  • A proven track record of resolving escalated or complex system issues that first-line service could not solve.

About us

QuantumDiamonds GmbH, headquartered in Munich, Germany, develops and manufactures semiconductor inspection systems based on quantum sensing. Spun out of the Technical University of Munich in 2022, the company uses nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond to map electrical current with micrometer precision inside advanced 2.5D and 3D chip architectures. Nine of the world's ten largest semiconductor manufacturers are engaged with QuantumDiamonds, with systems deployed across Europe, the United States, and Asia. description:
Bei Statista dreht sich alles um Daten und Fakten, denn wir sind die weltweit führende Business Data Plattform. Durch die Bereitstellung verlässlicher und einfach nutzbarer Daten sowie verschiedener Datenanalyseprodukte und -dienstleistungen unterstützen wir Menschen weltweit, faktenbasierte Entscheidungen zu treffen.

2007 in Hamburg gegründet, haben wir uns schnell zu einem globalen Unternehmen mit Büros in Metropolen wie London, New York und Tokio entwickelt. Und wir haben auch weiterhin viel vor. Unser stetiges Wachstum ist nicht nur Beweis für unseren Erfolg, sondern schafft auch immer neue Entwicklungs- und Karrieremöglichkeiten für unsere Mitarbeiter:innen.

Wir schätzen und feiern unsere vielfältige Kultur. Hier bist Du willkommen, egal, wer Du bist, woher Du kommst, wie Du aussiehst oder welche Graphen und Diagramme Du bevorzugst. Deine Geschichte ist wichtig – schreibe sie weiterhin als Teil unseres Teams. Überzeuge dich selbst und werde Teil unseres Teams!

Dein Job

'• Kreditorenbuchhaltung im Tagesgeschäft: Du bearbeitest Eingangsrechnungen und klärst Abweichungen und offene Posten eigenständig. Auch bei hohem Volumen sorgst du für zügige Bearbeitung und verlässlich hohe Qualität.

• Verantwortung für den Prozess: Du behältst den gesamten Purchase-to-Pay-Prozess (P2P) im Blick – von Bestellung über Wareneingang und Rechnungsprüfung bis zur Zahlung – und arbeitest eng mit den beteiligten Teams zusammen.

• Abschlüsse und Abstimmungen: Du stimmst Kreditorenkonten ab, bearbeitest Klärfälle und lieferst belastbare Beiträge zu den Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüssen.

• Prozessverbesserung und Projekte: Du analysierst bestehende Abläufe über Teamgrenzen hinweg, identifizierst Engpässe und setzt Verbesserungen gemeinsam mit den relevanten Schnittstellen um.

• Automatisierung und KI: Du prüfst, wo Automatisierung und KI die Bearbeitung sinnvoll unterstützen können, und gestaltest Lösungen mit, die Effizienz und Qualität verbessern – mit angemessenen Kontrollen und fachlicher Prüfung.

Dein Profil

'• Fundierte Praxis in der Kreditorenbuchhaltung: Du beherrschst das operative Geschäft sicher, priorisierst auch bei hohem Belegaufkommen gut und lieferst eigenständig präzise Ergebnisse.

• End-to-End-Verständnis: Du kennst die wesentlichen Teilbereiche des P2P-Prozesses aus der Praxis und hast bereits Projekte zur Analyse oder Verbesserung bereichsübergreifender Abläufe begleitet.

• SAP-Erfahrung: Du hast in der Kreditorenbuchhaltung mit SAP gearbeitet; Erfahrung mit SAP S/4HANA ist besonders willkommen.

• Gestaltungswille: Du hinterfragst Routinen konstruktiv, denkst über die eigene Aufgabe hinaus und setzt Verbesserungen pragmatisch um.

• Offenheit für neue Technologien: Du interessierst dich dafür, wie Automatisierung und KI Kreditorenprozesse verbessern können. Spezifische KI-Toolkenntnisse setzen wir nicht voraus.

• Sprachen: Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Was wir bieten

Neben unserem großartigen Team, unserer Unternehmenskultur und dem gemeinsamen Ziel, Menschen mit Daten zu empowern, gibt es viele weitere Gründe, warum Statista ein großartiger Arbeitsplatz ist! Werde Teil unseres Teams und profitiere von folgenden Vorteilen:

  • Arbeiten aus dem Ausland: 10 Tage pro Jahr (bis zu 30 Tage, wenn deine Familie im Ausland lebt)

  • Hybrides Arbeiten und flexible Arbeitszeiten

  • Internationales Team und regelmäßige Teamevents

  • Karriere- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten

  • Attraktive Standorte und moderne Büros

  • Unterstützung für mentale Gesundheit durch OpenUp

Einige der hier aufgeführten Benefits gelten nur für die deutsche Gesellschaft und für Positionen ab Junior-Level.

title: Head of Engineering (f/m/d)
description:
At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions.

Our culture is what makes that possible: we play to win, we obsess over quality, and we win as One Moss, and it works. Moss closed a €35 million Series C in August 2026, crossing a €1 billion valuation, and became one of Europe's fintech unicorns. Join us for what's next.

We're hiring a Head of Engineering to lead engineering for one of our product tribes. You'll manage 15 to 20 engineers directly, with tech leads in each squad owning technical direction but no management layer between you and the team. You report to the CTO and sit in a tribe leadership trio with the Product Tribe Lead and Design Lead. Which tribe you'd lead is something we'll work out with you during the process.

This is a people leadership role with a hard technical requirement. The engineers report to you, so hiring, development, performance and pace are yours. At the same time you have to hold your own on system architecture: challenge estimates from your engineers, spar with the Product Tribe Lead on solutions, and know when a design is wrong before it ships. This role needs both.

How we're set up

Tribes are the organisational body: people management, capacity, planning and reporting live there. Squads are assigned to problem spaces and run discovery and delivery, each led by a trio of Tech Lead, Product Manager and Product Designer. Tech Leads own the technical decisions in their squad, including estimates, and write code alongside their engineers. They don't manage people. You do.

We keep the structure deliberately flat. Management is anchored at tribe level, squad composition flexes to serve the most important work, and structure changes as we learn (roughly every six months in practice, not on a schedule). Discovery and delivery run in parallel: the next mission is scoped before engineers finish the current one, so engineers weigh in on architecture early and have the context to unblock themselves.

What you'll own

  • Feasibility and delivery for the tribe. You're accountable for tribe-wide delivery outcomes and velocity: the right problems, solved at the right quality, as fast as possible.

  • The people. 15 to 20 direct reports. Hiring, onboarding, expectations, feedback, development, compensation and promotion recommendations, and the tough calls that keep talent density high. Tech Leads feed you performance signals; the decisions and the conversations are yours.

  • Technical judgement across squads. Broad understanding of the tribe's systems and how they fit into the wider Moss architecture. You challenge estimates and technical proposals from your engineers; you don't produce the estimates yourself.

  • A seat in the tribe trio. Roadmap and planning input through a feasibility lens. You argue solutions and trade-offs with the Product Tribe Lead as a technical peer, and push back on scope and timelines when the engineering picture says so.

  • Operating rhythm. How the tribe plans, estimates, tracks and reports on delivery, with proactive, timely transparency to the tribe and to leadership, the good and the bad.

  • Capacity. Putting your best people on the most impactful work, moving engineers between squads (and, where it serves Moss, between tribes) while still letting people build real domain depth.

  • Alignment across tribes. Tribe leads aren't isolated trios. You align proactively with your peer Heads of Engineering and with platform and architecture owners, and you resolve shared-architecture questions through alignment, not around it.

How we expect leaders to operate

  • Velocity first, with high agency. Working smart and hard on the right problems.

  • Lead by example, stay close to the work. You know the details of what your team is building and course-correct in real time. You get hands-on when speed or quality is on the line.

  • End-to-end ownership of outcomes. Responsibility doesn't stop at your team's boundary. Make changes elsewhere when that's what it takes, communicating first, not unilaterally.

  • No waterfall, no blame. Product, Design and Engineering work together from the start. If there's a gap in the trio, fill it or name it.

  • Disagree and commit. Challenge when it matters. Once a call is made, own the message and explain the why, including for calls you argued against.

  • Proactive expertise. We build expert products for finance teams. Decisions rest on real expertise, internal and external, not assumptions.

Moss has one manager framework for every people leader, and this role is held to it in full: build a high-performing team, define success clearly, deliver results with your team, and operate with speed and ownership. You can hold us to it too.

What you bring

  • 4 to 6+ years in engineering management, with a track record of managing engineers directly at a meaningful span. You've run hiring, performance management and difficult conversations yourself, not through a layer of managers.

  • A senior engineering career before that. You've operated at senior or staff level as an engineer and your judgement on system design is current, not historical.

  • Strong systems design. You can read an architecture, spot where it will break, and argue an alternative with the people who built it. You can tell a 2-week estimate from a 6-week one and explain why.

  • Comfort as a technical peer to product leadership. You've shaped roadmaps and scope through feasibility arguments, and you've won and lost those arguments gracefully.

  • Structure at scale without a middle layer. You build the practices that make 15 to 20 direct reports work: clear expectations, regular feedback, visible delivery.

  • Fast in unfamiliar domains. You can reason about a new technical domain quickly and contribute before you have deep prior expertise in it.

  • Experience from an environment with mature engineering practices: code review, testing, incident handling, planning and estimation that actually work. You know what good looks like and can build it where it's missing.

Strong pluses

  • Background at an AI product company or in ERP / financial systems. Both are directly relevant to what we build.

  • Experience leading in a flat or tribe/squad-style organisation.

  • Experience with a Tech Lead / Engineering Manager split, as either side of it.

What this role is, and isn't

It's worth being clear about the shape of the job. Your technical contribution is judgement, challenge and architecture-level input; Tech Leads own the how and write the code alongside their squads, so this isn't a role with an IC workload attached. And it's a role where you manage engineers, not managers: every engineer in the tribe reports to you directly, there is no management layer beneath you, and we don't plan to add one. If that combination of deep people leadership and real technical engagement is what you're looking for, you'll find a lot to like here.

About Moss

Moss is the Finance AI platform for Europe's mid-sized businesses, giving companies real-time visibility and full control over their spend. By automating card issuing, invoice management and expenses, Moss simplifies financial workflows and frees finance and accounting teams from manual, administrative work.

Founded in Berlin and used by more than 10,000 businesses including Flink, Schufa, n8n and Auto1, Moss has raised €220+ million to date and operates in Germany, the Netherlands, the UK and further EU markets. In August 2026, Moss closed a €35 million Series C led by Portage, crossing a €1 billion valuation and becoming one of Europe's newest fintech unicorns. Moss is backed by investors including Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Global Founders Capital, Cherry Ventures, A-Star.

We're a team of 300+ people from 50+ nationalities across 5 offices in Europe and we hire, reward, and grow people based on Moss DNA: playing to win, obsessing over quality, winning as One Moss. If that's how you want to work, we want to hear from you. - here's what else to expect:

  • Top-of-market compensation package, including equity. 

  • Our vibrant offices are at the heart of our culture, where in-person time fuels collaboration and connection over weekly breakfasts and Friday demos.

  • Additional benefits include: 20 days “work from abroad”, 600EUR/GBP Learning & Development Budget, and other local benefits.

Unless stated otherwise, benefits apply to full-time positions (interns and working students receive a tailored package).

By applying for the above position, you will confirm that you have reviewed and agreed to our Data Privacy Policy.

title: Head of Operations (m/w/d) | Health & Beauty Scale-up
description:
MY HEALTH & BEAUTY ist Deutschlands erstes Health&Beauty-Startup mit dem Ziel, hochwertige ästhetische Medizin und Longevity-Health Behandlungen für eine breite Zielgruppe zugänglich, unkompliziert, bezahlbar und flächendeckend verfügbar zu machen.

Innerhalb von nur drei Jahren sind wir auf 10 Standorte und mehr als 50.000 Kunden gewachsen. Damit gehören wir zu den am schnellsten wachsenden Unternehmen im Bereich der ästhetischen Medizin in Deutschland.

Und wir stehen erst am Anfang.

In den kommenden Jahren wollen wir unseren Wachstumskurs deutlich beschleunigen und MY HEALTH&BEAUTY als die führende Marke für ästhetische Medizin und Longevity etablieren.

Unser Erfolgsmodell basiert auf einem klaren Anspruch: höchste medizinische Qualität ohne Kompromisse zugänglich für Alle.

Unsere Behandlungen werden ausschließlich von Ärzten durchgeführt. Wir arbeiten mit den hochwertigsten Produkten führender Hersteller und setzen auf standardisierte Prozesse, intensive Schulungen und eine konsequent hohe Behandlungs- und Servicequalität.

Unser Ziel ist nicht der kurzfristige "Verkauf" einzelner Behandlungen, sondern der Aufbau langfristiger Kundenbeziehungen durch Qualität, Vertrauen und ein konstant exzellentes Kundenerlebnis.

Der Markt für ästhetische Medizin und Longevity wächst sehr stark. Gleichzeitig verändern sich die Erwartungen der Kunden: Behandlungen sollen professioneller, zugänglicher und selbstverständlicher werden.

Genau diese Entwicklung treiben wir mit MY HEALTH & BEAUTY aktiv voran.

Aufgaben

Für die nächste Phase unseres Wachstums suchen wir einen Head of Operations, der die operative Entwicklung unserer HEALTH&BEAUTY Lounges verantwortet und gemeinsam mit uns die Grundlage für die nächsten 10, 20 oder 100 Standorte schafft.

Wir suchen ausdrücklich keinen Verwalter bestehender Strukturen.

Wir suchen jemanden, der Strukturen hinterfragt, Schwachstellen erkennt, Lösungen entwickelt und diese konsequent umsetzt.

Jemanden, der strategisch denkt und selbst vor Ort ist, mit Teams arbeitet, Trainings durchführt, Probleme löst und Verantwortung übernimmt.

Deine Verantwortung

Du trägst die operative Gesamtverantwortung für unsere Standorte und entwickelst gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung unsere Operations kontinuierlich weiter.

Leadership & People

Du führst unsere Kollegen und späteren Führungskräfte und sorgst dafür, dass Führung nicht nur auf dem Papier stattfindet, sondern im täglichen Geschäft spürbar ist.

Du entwickelst Mitarbeiter weiter, gibst klares Feedback und schaffst Verantwortlichkeiten.

Du erkennst Leistungsträger frühzeitig, entwickelst sie weiter.

Genauso konsequent gehst du mit Underperformance um.

Du sorgst gemeinsam mit unserem Recruiting Team dafür, dass unsere Standorte jederzeit mit den richtigen Menschen besetzt sind und wir auch bei starkem Wachstum oder Ausfällen unsere personellen Standards halten.

Training & Development

Du entwickelst strukturierte Trainings- und Weiterbildungsprogramme für unsere operativen Teams.

Du führst Trainings selbst durch und entwickelst gleichzeitig Strukturen, mit denen Wissen innerhalb der Organisation skalierbar weitergegeben werden kann.

Du etablierst klare Standards für Onboarding, Führung, Verkauf, Kundenservice und operative Abläufe.

Dabei misst du nicht nur, ob Trainings stattgefunden haben, sondern ob sie tatsächlich zu besserer Performance führen.

Operational Excellence

Du analysierst die operativen Prozesse des Unternehmens und stellst sie kontinuierlich infrage.

Was funktioniert, wird standardisiert.

Was nicht funktioniert, wird verändert.

Was unnötig kompliziert ist, wird vereinfacht.

Du entwickelst SOPs, Verantwortlichkeiten und Prozesse, die für jeden Standort klar verständlich und reproduzierbar sind.

Dein Anspruch ist, dass ein Kunde unabhängig vom Standort ein konstant hohes MY-HEALTH-&-BEAUTY-Erlebnis erhält.

Performance & KPIs

Du definierst gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung die relevanten operativen KPIs und stellst sicher, dass diese verstanden und konsequent gesteuert werden.

Dazu gehören insbesondere Produktivität, Personaleinsatz, Auslastung, Umsatzperformance, Kundenbindung, Servicequalität und operative Effizienz.

Wenn ein Standort seine Ziele verfehlt, analysierst du nicht nur die Zahlen, sondern findest heraus, warum.

Anschließend entwickelst du konkrete Maßnahmen, definierst Verantwortlichkeiten und stellst deren Umsetzung sicher.

Customer Experience & Qualitätsanspruch

Wir wollen nicht durchschnittlich gut sein.

Unser Anspruch ist ein außergewöhnlich hohes Niveau in jedem einzelnen Standort.

Du stellst sicher, dass unsere Standards hinsichtlich Kundenservice, Organisation, Sauberkeit, Auftreten, Kommunikation und operativer Qualität konsequent eingehalten werden.

Du erkennst Abweichungen frühzeitig und greifst ein, bevor aus kleinen Problemen strukturelle Probleme werden.

Dein Ziel ist klar:

Aus 10 erfolgreichen Standorten eine skalierbare, professionelle Operations-Struktur zu bauen, die auch mit weiteren 20, 30 oder 100 Standorten funktioniert.

Qualifikation

Diese Position ist bewusst nicht für jeden geeignet.

Wir suchen einen außergewöhnlich leistungsorientierten Menschen mit einem sehr hohen eigenen Anspruch.

Du solltest bereits bewiesen haben, dass du Menschen führen, operative Strukturen verbessern und Verantwortung für Ergebnisse übernehmen kannst.

Was du zwingend mitbringen solltest

Mehrjährige relevante Führungserfahrung in einer anspruchsvollen operativen Organisation.

Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Führung größerer Teams und mehrerer Führungsebenen.

Idealerweise hast du bereits Verantwortung für mehrere Standorte oder dezentrale operative Einheiten getragen.

Du hast Erfahrung darin, Mitarbeiter nicht nur zu verwalten, sondern tatsächlich zu entwickeln, zu motivieren und leistungsfähiger zu machen.

Du kannst professionelle Trainingskonzepte entwickeln und bist gleichzeitig stark genug in Kommunikation und Auftreten, diese Trainings selbst durchzuführen.

Du bist zahlengetrieben und kannst aus KPIs konkrete operative Entscheidungen ableiten.

Du hast bereits Prozesse aufgebaut oder grundlegend verbessert und kannst konkrete Beispiele nennen, bei denen deine Arbeit messbar zu besseren Ergebnissen geführt hat.

Du kannst gleichzeitig strategisch und extrem hands-on arbeiten.

Du kommunizierst klar, direkt und verbindlich und scheust dich nicht davor, auch unangenehme Entscheidungen zu treffen.

Du besitzt ein ausgeprägtes Verantwortungsgefühl und wartest bei Problemen nicht darauf, dass dir jemand sagt, was zu tun ist.

Was uns besonders wichtig ist

Wir suchen keine Person, die möglichst viele Aufgaben delegiert und Operations hauptsächlich aus Meetings und Reports heraus steuert.

Wir suchen jemanden, der das Unternehmen wirklich verstehen will.

Jemanden, der regelmäßig in unseren Standorten präsent ist.

Der mit Mitarbeitern spricht.

Der Kunden beobachtet.

Der Prozesse selbst durchläuft.

Der Probleme sieht, bevor sie in einem Dashboard auftauchen.

Und der anschließend Strukturen schafft, damit diese Probleme dauerhaft gelöst werden.

Du solltest einen außergewöhnlich hohen Anspruch an Qualität, Geschwindigkeit und Umsetzung haben.

Wir arbeiten in einem stark wachsenden Unternehmen. Damit gehen Veränderung, hohe Geschwindigkeit und Phasen außergewöhnlicher Belastung einher.

Wir suchen jemanden, der Verantwortung nicht an seiner Stellenbeschreibung oder an der Uhr festmacht. Wenn eine wichtige Standorteröffnung ansteht, ein Team Unterstützung benötigt oder ein operatives Problem gelöst werden muss, erwarten wir Ownership und die Bereitschaft, die Extrameile zu gehen.

Was für uns zählt, sind Ergebnisse.

Dein Mindset

Du denkst unternehmerisch.

Du willst gestalten statt verwalten.

Du stellst hohe Anforderungen an dich selbst und an dein Team.

Du kannst Menschen begeistern, aber genauso klare Grenzen setzen.

Du bist extrem lösungsorientiert.

Du suchst bei Problemen nicht nach Erklärungen, warum etwas nicht funktioniert, sondern nach dem schnellsten nachhaltigen Weg, es zu lösen.

Du kannst Prioritäten setzen und auch unter erheblichem Druck klar entscheiden.

Du hast keine Angst vor Verantwortung.

Benefits

Was wir dir bieten

Eine Schlüsselposition mit direktem Einfluss auf die weitere Entwicklung und Skalierung von MY HEALTH&BEAUTY.

Überdurchschnittliche Vergütung mit attraktivem Fixgehalt und leistungsabhängigem Bonus.

Firmenwagen, auch zur privaten Nutzung.

Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung und kurze Entscheidungswege.

Die Möglichkeit, Strukturen nicht nur zu übernehmen, sondern ein Operations-System für die nächsten 20, 30 oder 100 Standorte aktiv mit aufzubauen.

Keine Konzernbürokratie und keine endlosen Abstimmungsschleifen. Gute Ideen können schnell entschieden und umgesetzt werden.

Und vor allem: eine Rolle, in der du wirklich etwas aufbauen kannst, anstatt lediglich einen bestehenden Betrieb zu verwalten.

Du möchtest nicht einfach einen weiteren Job. Du möchtest maßgeblich daran beteiligt sein, ein Unternehmen von 10 Standorten zu der führenden Marken seiner Branche zu skalieren.

Wenn du dich darin wiederfindest und bereits nachweislich auf einem hohen Niveau gearbeitet hast, möchten wir dich gerne kennenlernen.

description:
About Nexoya

We help marketing teams unlock their growth potential with AI. Our attribution shows how advertising investments perform across channels, and our optimizations shift budgets to where they drive the bottom line. Leading European brands in e-commerce, telco, banking, insurance, energy and more rely on us.

The role

You build and run the Node.js/TypeScript services behind the Nexoya app: the GraphQL API, ad channel integrations and data ingestion, and new LLM- and agent-based features. You join a team of about 10 engineers across backend, ML, frontend and platform, and you own your features from design to production.

How we build software

AI coding agents change how software gets built, but not who is responsible for it.

  • Decisions are made together. Important technical decisions start as an Architecture Decision Record reviewed by the team. Good arguments win, not seniority.

  • Engineers design, agents implement. Your design is the input for our coding agents, guided by a shared rule set in our agent harness that the team evolves together.

  • Working is not done. Code is ready when it is maintainable: readable, tested, robust on unhappy paths. Larger changes are reviewed, so at least two engineers know every change.

  • You build it, you run it. A rotating internal support duty shows us which decisions worked.

What you will do

  • Ship backend features end to end on our Kubernetes-based Azure cloud.

  • Evolve our GraphQL API with clear schemas and stable contracts.

  • Build reliable ad channel integrations and data ingestion with MySQL and RabbitMQ.

What you bring

  • #fast: Wir vereinfachen Dinge, handeln mit Dringlichkeit und konzentrieren uns auf Ergebnisse.

getolo ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt fördert. title: Principal Forward Deployed Engineer (EMEA)
description:
About Docker

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

_______________________________________________________________________

The Role

Docker Forward Deployed Engineers (FDE) embed directly with our most strategic customers to solve important, complex technical problems and turn ambitious ideas into production outcomes. FDEs take on the most challenging technical challenges using existing Docker products and patterns when possible, and work across customer, Docker Product and Engineering teams to realize new approaches when required.

 

As a Docker FDE, you will work side-by-side with customer engineering teams to deeply understand their goals, problems, constraints, and technical landscape; identify the highest-leverage opportunities; and design, build, and ship solutions with them. You own the technical journey from discovery and architecture through prototyping, implementation and production rollout.

 

The solutions you build may use existing Docker products, extend Docker into new environments, integrate deeply with customer and third-party systems, or reveal capabilities that Docker should build next. You work closely with Docker Solutions Architects to evolve existing patterns, and Docker Product and Engineering to turn new learnings into reusable patterns and product capabilities.

_______________________________________________________________________

 

Responsibilities

Build in Production with Customers

  • Embed with customer engineering teams to design, build, and ship solutions from first prototype through stable production rollout. Use existing Docker products and patterns when possible, invent, prototype and validate innovative solutions when necessary.

  • Deliver working technical artifacts to customers: custom MCP servers with tightly integrated Docker Sandbox environments for coding agents and containerized agents; Docker Compose definitions for multi-agent harnesses and model-backed applications; Hardened Image standardization and migration; New tools that unblock customer progress.

  • Integrate Docker's AI platform with the customer's existing stack, including identity providers (OIDC/SAML/SSO), secrets management, private and air-gapped registries, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and observability tooling.

  • Own technical delivery on your engagements: scope the work, sequence it, make trade-offs between speed and quality, remove blockers early, and contribute directly to code whenever progress depends on it.

Make AI Adoption Safe and Governable

  • Translate customer security, compliance, and platform requirements into concrete plans and see those plans through from ideation to production.

  • Help customers define controls to enable them to adopt agentic AI to solve their unique business problems without compromising security, compliance, data sovereignty or end-user experience.

  • Establish quality and performance standards for customers and work closely with Docker Product and Engineering to quickly address issues that fall outside of established thresholds

  • Partner with customer security and platform teams to get agentic workloads through architecture review, threat modeling, and change control.

Partner with Solutions Architecture and the Field

  • Work closely with Solutions Architects to enable off-the-self solutions when possible and provide technical experience and leadership when a bespoke solution is necessary.

  • Feed implementation learnings back into reference architectures, SOW templates, and success patterns so that FDE innovations become standard features and implementation patterns.

  • Support the field with technical depth during proofs of concept, escalations, and expansion conversations when a working build is the fastest path to a customer adoption.

Close the Loop with Product and Engineering

  • As part of Docker Engineering FDEs work closely with Product and Engineering teams to fold FDE innovations, learnings, and design patterns into existing or new products and services.

  • Work with Customers, Product and Engineering to establish quality and performance thresholds, ensuring customer environments meet them consistently, and responding quickly and decisively when they don’t.

  • Be the voice of the customer. Deliver data-driven and actionable feedback to Product and Engineering: what works well; what does not; what customers are asking for; and what blocks their adoption and forward progress. FDE experience directly influences the roadmap.

Shape the Practice

  • Define the FDE engagement model, delivery standards, and quality bar, and codify them so that engagements are consistent across customers, regions, and delivery partners.

  • Mentor and lead other Forward Deployed Engineers, and participate in hiring loops to grow the team.

  • Act as the senior technical escalation point on the hardest problems impacting your customers. Every incident is an opportunity to improve Docker products and services.

  • Maintain deep, current knowledge of the agentic AI stack: LLMs, APIs, MCP, coding agents, model and harness evaluation approaches, performance and quality thresholds, deployment patterns.

  • This role may require participation in an on-call rotation to provide support outside of standard business hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, as needed.

_______________________________________________________________________

 

Qualifications

Required

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience, including 4+ years in a customer-facing technical role such as Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Professional Services Engineer, or Software Engineer with consulting or technical founder experience.

  • Technical leadership across multiple engagements, teams, or domains, with a proven ability to set delivery standards, define repeatable patterns, and influence product direction through field evidence.

  • Expert production coding skills in Go, Python, or TypeScript, with a track record of shipping and operating software that other people depend on and of leading technical design reviews.

  • Deep, hands-on Docker expertise: Dockerfiles and multi-stage builds, Docker Compose, image and registry operations, container networking and storage, and container security fundamentals.

  • Hands-on experience building with LLMs and agents in production, including tool use and function calling, the Model Context Protocol (MCP server and client implementation), prompt and context engineering, and evaluation of agent behavior.

  • Working knowledge of software supply chain security: SBOMs, image signing and attestation, vulnerability management, minimal and hardened base images, and secure CI/CD.

  • Experience integrating with enterprise systems: identity providers (Okta, Entra ID, LDAP/Active Directory), federated identity protocols (OIDC, SAML), secrets managers, Kubernetes, and at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, GCP).

  • Ability to scope and deliver complex work in ambiguous, fast-moving customer environments, making sound trade-offs between scope, speed, and quality.

  • Excellent communication skills with engineers, security and platform teams, and executive stakeholders, with a low-ego, collaborative approach and the ability to lead through influence rather than authority.

  • Proven track record of technical mentorship and of raising the bar for the engineers around you.

  • High agency and comfort operating autonomously in distributed, remote-first teams.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Travel to customer sites to build in person with customer teams, estimated at up to 50%.

Bonus

  • Experience with Docker Hardened Images, Docker Scout, MCP Gateway, MCP Toolkit, Docker Sandboxes, or Docker Model Runner.

  • Experience deploying and operating coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, or similar) in team or enterprise settings.

  • Experience with air-gapped, regulated, or compliance-driven environments in financial services, healthcare, government, or similar sectors.

  • Contributions to open source projects in the container, Kubernetes, or MCP ecosystems.

  • Prior experience founding or scaling a Forward Deployed Engineering or Professional Services practice.

Compensation & Equity

All full-time roles include equity. Final compensation is determined on factors including but not limited to experience, skills, qualifications, and location.

Europe: €121K – €198K base

Posting Information

  • Open vacancy: This posting is for an existing open role.

______________________________________________________________________

Perks & Benefits

  • Remote-first by design – Work from your home, with offices in Seattle and Paris for connection and collaboration.

  • Flexibility that fits your life – We trust you to manage your schedule while delivering great work.

  • Time to recharge – Generous PTO, designated quarterly Whaleness Days, and a designated end-of-year Whaleness break.

  • Docker swag – Because representing the whale never gets old.

Docker is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a team that reflects a broad range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe diverse teams build better products, make better decisions, and better serve our global community.

.

title: Software Engineering Internship - London
description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara interns dive into challenging, real-world projects with the same freedom and responsibility as our full-time engineers. You won't just be learning; you'll be building and making a tangible impact on our global customers from day one. You'll join a team working at a scale few engineers encounter early in their careers: millions of IoT devices deployed globally, petabytes of real-time data, and software that directly affects the safety of people doing some of the most essential work in the world. You'll be paired with an Engineering mentor, get rare exposure to customers, and have visibility to engineering leadership throughout your internship. You'll also have access to the latest AI tools, with generous token allotments, giving you the leverage to ship more and learn faster.

At Samsara, interns can work on a wide range of high-impact engineering challenges across our connected operations platform. Depending on the team, an intern may help build the backend infrastructure that powers our IoT platform, scaling data ingestion and storage systems that support over 15,000 hardware assets and tens of thousands of customers around the world. They may also work across the full stack, creating intuitive user experiences that turn data into actionable insights, while partnering closely with product and design to rapidly iterate on features that deliver real customer value.

On the mobile side, an intern could help strengthen the infrastructure behind our React Native app, enabling feature teams to move quickly and build performant, maintainable products. For those focused on embedded software, projects may include building and maintaining software that runs directly on Samsara hardware, spanning areas like edge AI, multimedia frameworks, power management, and real-time data processing in demanding real-world environments. 

Throughout the interview process, we will dig into your past experience, what you are most interested in learning next, and where you would be the best fit across our engineering teams.

Our engineering teams use Golang for backend development, TypeScript and React for the web client, GraphQL for data access, and React Native for mobile development. Direct experience with this exact stack is not required, but experience with similar technologies is strongly encouraged. 

You should apply if…

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world. The software you build will help keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and - most importantly - ensure workers return home safely.
  • You want to build for scale. You'll work on technology that powers physical operations at a scale most engineers never experience.
  • You believe customers are more than a number. Our engineers are deeply invested in our customers and the daily problems they face. They visit customers in person to understand not just how Samsara helps them today, but where our products need to go next. You'll participate in customer interviews, collaborate with success and product teams, and use metrics to ensure your work translates into real outcomes.
  • You're curious and self-driven. You challenge yourself outside of class - hackathons, side projects, tearing apart how something works just because you want to understand it. You move fast, embrace new technology, and treat learning as constant.
  • You're drawn to hard problems and own them end to end. You dig into complexity, research it thoroughly, and find the simplest solution that works - then see it through, holding yourself to a high standard along the way.
  • You're AI-forward. You've woven AI into how you work, whether that's accelerating debugging, drafting code, or exploring unfamiliar problem spaces faster. You're quick to experiment and always looking for smarter ways to build.
  • You're a collaborator. You work well independently and across cross-functional teams, and you're motivated by winning together, not just individually.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Currently in your penultimate year of study (or second-to-last year of an integrated Master's / MEng), on track to complete a Bachelor's or integrated Master's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Software Engineering, Physics, or Data Science, with expected graduation no earlier than Summer 2028.

title: Engineering Manager - Cx App Foundations
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

About the Team

Cx App Foundations is a platform organisation within our global Cx organisation. It provides shared consumer foundations and platform capabilities used by engineering teams across Wolt, DoorDash, and Deliveroo. Within this organisation, the Velocity team owns the paved road for consumer app development across mobile and web: shared SDKs and client foundations, integration patterns and multi-brand customisation, migration playbooks and reference implementations, and developer tooling that makes building on shared foundations fast and safe. Our mission is to reduce the cost, time, and risk of building consumer experiences across platforms and brands. Product teams own customer-facing experiences; our job is to make sure they can spend their time on delivering delightful experiences. The team is AI-native: AI is a default part of how we design, build, and ship software.

About the Role

As the Engineering Manager, you will lead a team of experienced engineers across mobile and web, collaborating closely with product teams, design, and adjacent platform organisations across three brands. Your primary responsibility will be owning the team's roadmap and delivery of shared client foundations, and driving their adoption across the organisation, so that product teams ship delightful customer experiences without rebuilding the foundations under them. You will be a key player in keeping the team's operating model healthy: clear intake from stakeholders, predictable delivery, and support expectations that keep the platform from drifting into a general escalation queue. You will also guide architectural and system design decisions with your tech leads. You will stay hands-on: contributing code, reviews, and prototypes alongside the team is part of the job. This role is ideal for a leader who has run platforms, SDKs, or shared services for other engineering teams, communicates clearly across brands and time zones, and wants their impact measured through what other teams achieve with the foundations you ship.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Own the platform roadmap - the shared SDKs, client foundations, and developer tooling the team ships - and sequence it against the migration and adoption goals of the three brands
  • Drive adoption of the shared foundations by partnering with product teams, running onboarding and rollout support, and making the supported path the easiest path
  • Lead, coach, and grow experienced mobile and web engineers, keeping growth conversations, calibration, and feedback loops running
  • Keep the team's operating model healthy: clear intake (stakeholder management, shared-platform, product-specific, or exception work), supported capabilities with entry criteria and support expectations, and predictable delivery
  • Guide architectural and system design decisions for client foundations that three brands and multiple app platforms depend on
  • Stay hands-on by contributing code and reviews alongside the team, and champion AI-native development practices
  • Grow the team through hiring

 

Our humble expectations

  • You have 3+ years of experience managing engineers, including a team with senior engineers
  • You have a solid background (5+ years) in mobile or web engineering, with enough technical depth to hold your own in architecture discussions about client foundations
  • You use AI tooling fluently in your day-to-day work and stay close to the code
  • You have run a platform, SDK, or shared service that other teams depend on, and know how to treat internal customers as customers
  • You work across boundaries naturally: product teams, design, other platform organisations, data/analytics and stakeholders in other locations and time zones
  • You hold a high bar for engineering quality and can navigate production incidents and release tradeoffs with calm structure

What we offer

A platform leadership role with real leverage: the foundations the team owns shape how consumer experiences get built across Wolt, DoorDash, and Deliveroo, and your roadmap decisions multiply across every product team that builds on them.

Next steps

The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

The compensation will be a combination of monthly pay and DoorDash RSUs. The latter makes it exceptionally easy to be excited about our company growing and doing well, as you'll own a piece of the pie.

 

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

As the CASS Oversight Manager, you are responsible for ensuring that client money and custody assets held by Upvest Securities are protected, segregated and accounted for in full compliance with the FCA’s Client Assets Sourcebook (CASS).

You will act as the primary day-to-day authority on CASS, bridging the gap between complex regulatory requirements, our operational processes, our client’s needs and our scalable investment API. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Compliance, Client and Operations teams to ensure our client asset framework remains robust, evidenced and audit-ready, enabling Upvest to scale its financial infrastructure to millions of end-users while maintaining the highest levels of integrity and trust with regulators, clients, and partners.

  • Set the bar, full stop. If it ships under the Siena name, you made it or you signed off on it

Who You Are

Not a Fit If:

Why Siena?

Real ownership. You will own problems, not tasks, with the autonomy to solve them your way and the trust to do it without a manager in your inbox.

Work that ships and matters. What you build reaches real consumer brands fast.

A category we are creating. The Agent of Record is new ground, with unsolved problems and cutting-edge models, not a crowded field to compete in.

A team that respects your judgment. Globally distributed, async-first, low bureaucracy. We hire adults and treat you like one.

Great salary plus equity or stock grants. Own a piece of what you build.

Learning budget. If you are growing, so are we.

AI-fluency by default. Few places will push your work with production AI further or faster.

The people who thrive here are curious, customer-obsessed, and take ownership without being asked. They fix problems first and explain later. They're direct about feedback - both giving and receiving it - because they care more about getting things right than being polite.

They maintain high standards while moving at startup speed, and they build real relationships with teammates because they know that's how great work gets done. When things get tough, they adapt and keep pushing forward.

title: Senior Software Engineer (AI/Data)
description:
About Codat

Codat is an advisory intelligence solution purpose-built for modern commercial banking. Through rich, specialized data, forward-looking insights, and integrated workflows, Codat empowers banking teams to deepen their relationships, grow their revenue, and simplify their day-to-day work.

Founded in 2017 and backed by JPMorgan, PayPal, Amex, Plaid, and Shopify, Codat has successfully powered over 350,000 connections to business customers’ financial systems — and is trusted by industry leaders to turn scattered information into actionable, strategic advantages in real time, every time.

The Role

We're building the Advisory Intelligence Platform: Codat's client intelligence delivered inside the assistant a banker already uses (Microsoft Copilot first). Ask it anything about a client and it answers from the client's real books. Don't ask, and it still tells you what's changed, why it matters and what to do about it. Under it we're building the semantic layer, so every answer uses the same definitions, the signal layer that spots what's changed for a client, and the reasoning layer, a Codat-side LLM that turns those signals into advice. The first bank goes live this year. You'll be building the data and reasoning behind all of it.

This is a hands-on job for software engineers who want to build the systems a model reasons over, not configure a warehouse. Codat is AI-first, not AI bolted onto SaaS. The product lives inside the AI assistant our clients already use, and we build it the same way: agents do the repetitive work, engineers do the hard parts. You'll build it and you'll run it. Nobody hands it over the wall once it's live. You'll also get a real say in where it goes next. That means making your case to engineers, product and the commercial team, and bringing them along with you.

What You'll Work On

  • The semantic layer. Measures, dimensions and definitions the model is allowed to use, so every answer it gives is the same answer. Yours to grow, persona by persona.

  • The signal layer. Detecting what's changed for a client and surfacing it before the banker asks. You'll be designing and building this.

  • The reasoning layer. A Codat-side LLM that turns signals into advice. Our calculations are the ground truth it reasons over. You own the calculations the model relies on, and the names, definitions and structure that let it pick the right one.

  • The agents and MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers behind the assistant. What tools it has, how they're built, how they fail, and the evals that prove they work.

  • Everything from raw source data to the number the assistant quotes: the pipelines, services and data models, with the testing and observability to prove the number is right and the evals that catch the model quoting the wrong one.

You'll Probably Have

  • Built production systems from scratch, writing the code yourself rather than configuring managed services. You think about interfaces, failure modes and how the next person will change your code. If we ask about the hardest system you've built, you'll have a story ready.

  • Served data to an LLM and seen where it goes wrong: ambiguous definitions, poor retrieval, no evals. You know why "the model will work it out" isn't a data strategy.

  • Worked with data along the way, and liked it. You may never have been called a data engineer. You've built things that move, shape and serve data, and you know how they break, and how a model breaks on top of them.

  • Solid C#, Python or another backend language. Your code comes with tests, and you leave things tidier than you found them.

  • Depth in at least one of SQL, Spark, Databricks/Delta Lake, Dagster/Airflow/Temporal or dbt. Bonus if you've shaped any of them into something a model can query, through a metrics layer, metric views or an MCP server.

  • Time with CI/CD, Docker, cloud infrastructure (we're on Azure) and observability. Even better if you set them up for a team.

  • An interest in the business behind the data. If someone asks for a number the data can't support, you'll say so, and you'll build the guard-rail so the model says so too.

  • Treated your own workflow as something to engineer. AI has already taken over the repetitive parts of it, and you're the person others ask how to do the same.

How We Work

We're a small team with plenty to do. Things move fast: we'd rather ship something useful and improve it than polish it in private. What you build is yours from start to finish.

There’s no return-to-office mandate, and you can work hybrid or fully remote. We trust you to be around when the team needs you and to deliver what you said you would. What we don’t want is anyone staying online late to prove a point.

description:
Dans le cadre de la migration de notre application desktop, nous recherchons un.e stagiaire pour piloter le suivi de l’adoption et accompagner nos clients tout au long de leur transition vers la nouvelle solution.

L’objectif sera de permettre au plus grand nombre de clients de migrer dans les meilleures conditions avant le transfert progressif du suivi à notre équipe Support, à l’issue du stage.

Piloter la communication autour de la migration

Tu construiras et déploieras un plan de communication adapté aux différentes étapes de la migration :

  • Gestion des objections, questions et éventuels points de blocage ;

  • Formalisation des bonnes pratiques et des argumentaires.

Prioriser les migrations

Tu contribueras à définir une stratégie de priorisation des clients en fonction de différents critères :

  • Taille et typologie des établissements ;

  • Contraintes liées à l’environnement informatique ;

  • Niveau d’engagement et de réponse des interlocuteurs ;

  • Risques identifiés et complexité de l’accompagnement nécessaire.

L’objectif sera de concentrer les efforts sur les clients présentant le meilleur potentiel de progression ou nécessitant un accompagnement spécifique.

title: Operations Manager, IT & Security
description:
At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store.

From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US.

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!

🔥 Our Business Operations team

At Joko, the Business Operations team is the powerhouse behind internal innovation. We tackle the company’s most strategic and complex challenges and we don’t just solve them, we turn them into long-term, scalable growth engines. Whether it's launching entirely new business lines, rethinking revenue infrastructure, or embedding AI into our operations, we lead high-impact initiatives that push Joko forward faster, smarter, and stronger.

Our mission: Help Joko operate at its absolute best, every single day.

🦾 The role in one sentence

Security is Joko’s number one priority, and you will own it where it touches every employee: from every laptop to every identity and tool. You turn the initiatives already underway into a secure-by-design, automated foundation, so a fast-growing, AI-driven company can move fast, safely.

🎯 Context

Joko is the AI shopping app that helps millions of people save time and money: 7 million users, 10,000 merchants and a team of ~120 people from 18 nationalities, heading to 200+ by the end of 2027. Enterprise-grade security (SSO, MFA, audits) is one of our six company-wide priorities for 2026, and our internal IT foundation needs to scale with us: identity management, device management, business tooling, and endpoint security. This is a rare chance to own that foundation at a pivotal moment, with a blank canvas to build on and a company-wide priority behind you. This role sits at the intersection of IT Ops and security — a cross-functional role that touches everyone in the company.

🚀 Your missions

1. IT foundation & identities

  • Set up an Identity Provider (company-wide SSO, plus SCIM for access lifecycle management), and own the password manager while ensuring MFA is activated wherever possible.

  • Make access zero-touch: our goal is to connect most of our tools to the Identity Provider so access is granted and removed automatically. You build the integrations and automations (SSO, SCIM, low-code workflows) that make it happen.

  • Deploy an MDM solution for centralised device management (device fleet, configuration, compliance).

  • Review our company tooling catalogue: make sure everyone has the minimum access they need, and that security audits are up to date.

2. Security of the working environment

  • Drive security best practices for the working environment (endpoint hardening, access management, ongoing team awareness such as training and phishing simulations).

  • Be the go-to owner of the security of our employees' working environment.

  • Security review of new tools: run the security audit on every new tool, including AI tools, and on any new way of using the tools we already have, before it is rolled out.

  • Own the AI security policy: define, maintain and promote Joko’s AI security policy.

3. Day-to-day run

  • Access management: With tool owners, manage access across our stack (Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, Keeper, AI tools, business SaaS): permissions, roles, reviews, onboarding, offboarding and external users. Your mission: automate today’s largely manual processes and make them as efficient as possible.

  • Security alert & incident management: monitor, triage and handle alerts from our identity, device and endpoint security tools, and act as first responder on incidents affecting the working environment (compromised account, lost device, phishing, malware alert). Build and maintain incident response playbooks, and run post-incident reviews so we keep improving.

  • Fleet management: In collaboration with the people team, device onboarding and offboarding.

  • First-line employee support: helping colleagues with technical questions related to our tools.

💚 Why you'll love this role

  • Build, don't just maintain: you choose, deploy and shape the IdP, MDM and EDR stack from day one.

  • Real ownership and visibility: your work is felt by every employee, every day, and directly supports one of the company's top priorities.

  • A pioneering topic: help define how we safely adopt AI agents and AI-powered workflows, in a company where everyone uses AI daily.

  • A company on the rise: 7M users, 10k merchants, and a team growing from ~120 to 200+ — with a strong international, partly remote culture.

👀 Who we're looking for

  • A builder at heart: you automate everything you can, and you’d rather build a tool or workflow than repeat a manual task. Showing you’ve built and automated things matters as much as your previous experience in IT & Security.

  • Solid IT fundamentals (identities, device management, endpoint security, enterprise SaaS tooling), gained over ~4-7 years in IT Ops, security or systems administration.

  • Strong cross-functional communication: able to gather context from business teams and translate security stakes into plain language.

  • Rigor, autonomy, and a taste for building clear, durable processes.

  • Open and eager to learn on emerging topics — notably AI agents and their security — and excited to help build this area from the ground up.

✨ What would make the difference (nice to have)

  • Experience with an enterprise EDR / anti-malware.

  • Awareness of security frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001…).

  • Hands-on experience deploying an IdP (Okta, Google Workspace, Entra ID…) and/or an MDM (Jamf, Kandji, Intune…).

💎 Our perks

(Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only)

At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:

  • Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget.

  • Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year.

On top of that, we offer plenty of perks:

  • 💸 Top-market compensation

  • 📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build

  • 🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills

  • 🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings

  • 💪 Contribution to your ClassPass subscription

  • 🍼 8-week leave paid 100% for the second parent

  • …and much more, check the full list here!

🤝 Our hiring process

  1. Intro call: Quick screening with the Hiring Manager or the Talent team.

  2. Step 1 – Team interview (45 min): Conversation with two Joko team members (could include the Hiring Manager, people from the team you’d join, or colleagues from other teams).

  3. Step 2 – Role-specific assessments

    • For non-engineering roles: A take-home case study followed by a 45-min interview. We assess both your output and how you think in real time. The exercise will be relevant to your role (e.g. analysis, strategy, or process design).

    • For engineering roles: A 90-min live technical interview on CoderPad covering code understanding, review, system design, and product thinking (with AI serving as a collaboration tool).

The Finance team ensures Joko's financial health and long-term success. We manage everything from financial planning and accounting to financing and cash management.

We make sure every euro is put to its best use, working closely with all teams, we provide the insights and structure needed to scale efficiently.

As we scale, we're splitting Finance into three specialized poles: FP&A, Finance Operations, and Procurement, each with its own ressources. Today, the team consists of 2 people but are actively recruiting toward a target organization of 7. Most of it is still to be hired and built — by you. You will report to Quentin, our COO.

✨ Why this role is special

  • You build the function instead of inheriting it. The target organization — FP&A, Finance Operations, Procurement — exists on paper and almost nothing of it is built. You recruit the team, set the standards, and decide how Finance operates for the next stage of the company. The role is designed to grow into VP Finance once the function is in place.

  • You get a genuinely 360 scope. Planning, accounting close, cash, financing, multi-entity structuring, procurement, and investor relations all sit with you — across multiple business lines, in France, Spain, and the US, with more markets coming. Very few finance leaders get that full surface at this stage.

  • You join a profitable company that is moving fast. Joko is already profitable and keeps growing quickly, with new business lines and countries opening. You build a finance function for a company on the offensive, not one managing a slowdown.

  • You sit at the table where the decisions are made. You partner directly with the COO and the co-founders on market expansion, investment allocation, and business line priorities, with the numbers you built as the basis of the discussion.

🎯 What you will do

This is a builder role. We are looking for a finance leader who runs the core of Finance hands-on today and builds the team that will run it tomorrow. Over the next two years, your mandate is to recruit the people the function is missing, set up the three poles, and put in place the processes that let you step back from the day-to-day.

We prefer to say it upfront: if what excites you is leading a team that already exists, this is not the role. If you want to build one on solid foundations and grow with it, it is a great one.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Build and lead the Finance team: manage and develop the current 2 team, recruit the next hires across FP&A, Finance Operations, and Procurement, and set how the team works;

  • Own planning and reporting: budget, forecast, and actuals vs. budget across all business lines (Online, Card-Linked, Gift Cards) and geographies. Our modeling combines elasticity-based CAC projections, cohort-based revenue models, and granular bottom-up cost budgets — you will own it, keep improving it.

  • Run the accounting close and controls: monthly and annual closing with our external accountants across France, Spain, and the US, the audit of our financial statements, and robust controls to prevent fraud and errors. Build toward group consolidation under international standards (IFRS) as entities are added;

  • Manage cash and financing: day-to-day cash visibility, Gift Cards working capital, multi-currency flows, and our relationships with banks and financing partners. Cash is king — make sure the whole company knows it;

  • Structure a multi-entity group: how our entities are organized, intercompany flows, transfer pricing, cost allocation, and local compliance as we open new countries;

  • Be the financial voice at the leadership table: partner with the COO and co-founders on market expansion, investment allocation, pricing, and business line priorities;

  • Support investor relations: investor model, financial reporting, and fundraising preparation;

  • Drive cost efficiency: work with budget owners on their targets and negotiate key supplier contracts;

  • Do the work, with AI: you will be a high-level individual contributor as much as a manager. We expect you to use AI to automate repetitive work (reporting, reconciliation, data extraction) and augment analysis, so a lean team operates like a much larger one;

  • Coordinate with external partners: accountants, auditors, and financial advisors.

👀 Who we're looking for

  • Experience: You have 10+ years of experience combining traditional finance (audit, transaction services, corporate finance, investment banking, or private equity) and finance in a high-growth tech company or scale-up. Ideally, you have done several cycles in companies at a stage close to ours.

  • Breadth: You have worked hands-on on at least two of the three pillars of a finance function: FP&A and business projection, accounting / financial control / cash, and financing / structuring / procurement. You are a 360 finance profile, not a specialist of one area.

  • Ownership: You have run a finance function, or a large part of one, end to end, and you have led or coordinated a team. You are ready to build a bigger one.

title: Senior IT Engineer
description:
About Morpho

Morpho is a leading Decentralized Finance (DeFi) lending protocol backed by a16z crypto, Paradigm, Ribbit Capital, Apollo, Vaneck, Coinbase Ventures, Variant and 50 others to build an open credit network giving anyone, anywhere, access to the best possible terms. Morpho is experiencing exponential adoption, with over billion in deposits on the network and used by institutional clients including Bitwise, Galaxy, and Anchorage Digital and the largest crypto exchanges, such as Coinbase, Binance, and Kraken. Now, Morpho is scaling its team of contributors to establish itself as the open credit network, not just of DeFi, but of the world.

 

Why Morpho Exists

Everyone has the potential to build something great for the world. But fulfilling that ambition almost always requires more: people willing to trust you with their capital. Yet access to capital still depends on where you live, who you know, and which institutions are willing to trust you. Even when capital is available, it sits fragmented across disconnected networks and hidden behind intermediaries. The result is a system that fails most of the people it should serve. Borrowers overpay. Lenders earn less than they should. Many are shut out entirely, not because they are unworthy of credit, but because today's infrastructure was never built to connect them. Morpho exists to solve this. Full article here.

About the role

You’ll run Morpho’s corporate IT: accounts and access, laptops, and the SaaS tools the company runs on, all set up securely. You’ll work closely with the security team: they set policy and lead on incidents, and you put that policy in place across our tools and devices. The scope is broad and the work is hands-on. We’d rather automate repetitive work than hire for it, so expect to write scripts and build your own tooling, using AI where it helps. We’ll go through our stack with you early in the process.

Responsibilities
