title: Talent Acquisition Partner / Corporate Recruiter
description:
Talent Acquisition Partner / Corporate Recruiter

Are you an experienced Corporate Recruiter who enjoys building strong relationships with hiring managers, finding the right talent and continuously improving the recruitment process? Join our HR team in De Lier and help us attract the people who will contribute to Priva’s future.

 

For this position, we are looking for a Dutch-speaking Talent Acquisition Partner who lives within commuting distance of our office in De Lier, the Netherlands. Excellent communication skills in both Dutch and English are required.

 

At Priva, our HR team is close-knit, energetic and ambitious. We believe recruitment is about more than filling vacancies. It is about understanding the business, challenging hiring managers when needed, creating an excellent candidate experience and finding people who truly fit our organization and ambitions.

As our new Corporate Recruiter, you will focus primarily on non-technical and commercial vacancies, including roles within account management, customer support, fulfillment and other business functions.

You will have the freedom to take ownership of your recruitment portfolio while working closely with hiring managers, HR colleagues and other stakeholders across the organization.

 

Climate for growth

Priva develops innovative solutions for horticulture and building automation. Our technology helps customers create smarter, healthier and more sustainable environments while reducing the use of valuable resources such as energy and water.

 

Our ambition is to contribute to a world where people can live and work in healthy, comfortable and sustainable environments. We call this creating a climate for growth. We encourage our employees to take ownership, think entrepreneurially and continuously look for ways to improve.

 

How you add value as a Corporate Recruiter

As a Corporate Recruiter, you are a strategic recruitment partner for your hiring managers and responsible for the full recruitment lifecycle of the vacancies within your portfolio. You understand what the business needs, translate those needs into attractive and realistic candidate profiles and know how to reach the right talent. At the same time, you keep a sharp eye on recruitment quality, candidate experience and an efficient hiring process.

You will:

·       Manage full-cycle recruitment for primarily non-technical and commercial positions;

·       Partner with hiring managers and leadership to define profiles, recruitment strategies and selection criteria;

·       Develop effective candidate sourcing strategies using LinkedIn Recruiter and AI-supported sourcing tools;

·       Proactively source and engage relevant talent in the market;

·       Help hiring managers create structured and effective interview and selection processes;

·       Ensure an excellent candidate experience throughout the recruitment journey;

·       Contribute to the further development of our employer branding and talent attraction activities;

·       Use recruitment insights and market knowledge to advise the business;

·       Identify opportunities to continuously improve our recruitment processes and ways of working.


Who you are

You are an experienced recruiter who combines strong people skills with a practical and business-oriented approach. You enjoy taking ownership, working independently and building trusted relationships with hiring managers.

You are proactive, curious and not afraid to challenge the business when you believe there is a better way to attract or select talent.

 

For this role, we are looking for someone who:

·       Has 3–5 years of experience in corporate recruitment or talent acquisition, preferably within a product, technology or international organization;

·       Has experience managing the full recruitment lifecycle, from intake and sourcing to selection and offer;

·       Is confident using LinkedIn Recruiter and proactive sourcing techniques;

·       Has experience working closely with hiring managers and other business stakeholders;

·       Understands the importance of candidate experience and employer branding;

·       Is independent, proactive and comfortable working in a dynamic environment;

·       Has a continuous improvement mindset and enjoys making recruitment processes better;

·       Communicates fluently in Dutch and English, both written and spoken;

·       Lives within reasonable commuting distance of De Lier, the Netherlands.


What you get   
In numbers 

·       A monthly salary between €3.600,00 - €5.100,00 based on your experience; 

·       We find a healthy work-life balance important: working flexible hours combined with 30 vacation days a year and the option to buy more; 

·       8% holiday allowance; 

·       Travel allowance of € 0,23/km with a daily maximum of 150 kilometers. 

 

For your own sustainability 

·       Be secured with our pension plan; 

·       Feel engaged and join our participation plan; 

·       Keep on learning with your personal education possibilities and budget; 

·       Be happy and fit by using our healthy cafeteria, our free on-premises fitness where you can participate in CrossFit, Pilates and Spinning classes or play table tennis or table football.

 

Ready to help us find the people behind our future?

If recruitment is more than filling vacancies to you, and you enjoy combining sourcing, stakeholder management and candidate experience, we would love to hear from you.

Apply and discover how you can help us create a climate for growth.

title: Stage Eventmanagement
description:

Wat ga je doen?
Samen met de Event Manager zorg je ervoor dat events soepel verlopen. Je houdt overzicht, pakt zelfstandig werkzaamheden op en zorgt dat afspraken worden nagekomen.

Denk bijvoorbeeld aan:

  • Meewerken aan de voorbereiding en planning van events;

  • Contact onderhouden met leveranciers en andere eventpartners;

  • Ondersteunen bij registraties, uitnodigingen en deelnemerscommunicatie;

  • Organiseren en beheren van eventmaterialen en promotiemiddelen;

  • Planningen en draaiboeken voorbereiden en bijhouden;

  • Offertes en praktische afspraken met leveranciers opvolgen;

  • Helpen bij de logistieke voorbereiding van events;

  • Meedenken over hoe we onze events slimmer en efficiënter kunnen organiseren;

  • Tijdens eventdagen zelf de handen uit de mouwen steken en verantwoordelijkheden oppakken.

Je zit niet alleen achter je laptop, maar ervaart hoe een event daadwerkelijk tot leven komt. Je werkt samen met de Event Manager, leveranciers, collega's en andere betrokkenen en krijgt steeds meer verantwoordelijkheid.

Tijdens je stage werk je toe naar een van de grootste events binnen Priva: GreenTech Amsterdam in juni 2027. Een event waar veel bij komt kijken en waar je vanaf de voorbereiding tot en met de eventdagen bij betrokken bent. Van planning en leverancierscontact tot materialen, logistiek en de uitvoering op locatie: je ziet letterlijk het resultaat van jouw werk terug op de beursvloer.

Na GreenTech 2027 zit jouw stage erop. Een mooie manier om je stageperiode af te sluiten én een event van formaat van dichtbij mee te maken.

Wie zijn wij?

Wij zijn Priva! Priva is een familiebedrijf, gevestigd in het Westland. Het is de missie van Priva om een ​​optimale omgeving te creëren waarin zowel planten als mensen kunnen werken, groeien en zich ontwikkelen. Wij bieden wereldwijde oplossingen voor de tuinbouw, gebouwautomatisering en alles daartussenin. Wij zijn toonaangevend in de ontwikkeling en productie van technologie voor het optimaliseren van omgevingsomstandigheden en processen.

Onze ambitie is om bekend te staan ​​als de toonaangevende technologie- en dienstverlener voor duurzame stedelijke delta's. We zijn er trots op dat onze oplossingen resulteren in een lager verbruik van natuurlijke hulpbronnen, zoals energie en water. Om onze missie en ambitie waar te maken, zijn we op zoek naar toegewijde collega's. We zijn er trots op dat we met ruim 500 collega's, in 16 internationale vestigingen verdeeld over 12 landen samen met meer dan 400 internationale installatiepartners werken aan het leveren van onze duurzame oplossingen en diensten in meer dan 100 landen.


Wat zoeken we in jou?
We zoeken geen student die afwacht tot er een taak wordt gegeven. We zoeken iemand die ziet wat er moet gebeuren en het leuk vindt om het te regelen. Iemand die creatieve ideeen heeft en durft voorstellen te doen.

Je:

  • volgt een mbo-, hbo- of vergelijkbare opleiding richting Eventmanagement, Leisure & Events, Marketing, Communicatie of Hospitality;

  • zoekt een meewerkstage en geen afstudeerstage;

  • bent vanaf februari 2027 beschikbaar;

  • bent georganiseerd en houdt ervan om overzicht te creëren;

  • Beheerst zowel de Nederlandse als Engelse taal goed, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.

  • vindt het leuk om met verschillende mensen en leveranciers te schakelen;

  • bent praktisch ingesteld en denkt graag in oplossingen;

  • durft vragen te stellen, maar kunt ook zelfstandig aan de slag;

  • vindt het leuk als geen dag precies hetzelfde is;

  • hebt interesse in zakelijke events, beurzen en marketing.

Ervaring met events is mooi meegenomen, maar enthousiasme, initiatief en organisatietalent vinden we belangrijker.

Wat krijg je ervoor terug?
Bij Priva krijg je geen stage waarin je vooral meekijkt. Je wordt onderdeel van het team en krijgt de ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen.

Je krijgt:

title: Senior Backend Engineer – Energy Optimization & Platform
description:
At Priva Energy, we build software systems that help customers manage and optimize energy in real-world environments, from greenhouses to buildings. You'll join one of our Energy Solutions teams (spanning Building Automation, Horticulture, and Energy Flexibility Trading), landing wherever the need is greatest at the time, and you'll also carry some responsibility for the cloud infrastructure and scalability that benefits teams beyond your own. 

You'll work at the intersection of three things: shipping features end-to-end in Priva Digital Services (touching both backend and, where needed, the front end), integrating optimization and forecasting logic into production services, and strengthening the cloud/DevOps foundation the whole department builds on. You don't need to be equally deep in all three, but you do need to be comfortable moving between them, and you should genuinely enjoy the connective, systems-level work of making things run reliably in production. 

 

Come Shape the Future of Sustainable Energy with Priva 

Priva Energy is working to become the leading global lifecycle partner for high-performing, sustainable buildings, horticultural operations, and energy distribution and management companies. Energy systems are transforming fast: grid congestion, dynamic pricing, decentralized production, and tightening sustainability regulation are reshaping what our customers need from us. Our Digital Twin and optimization technologies exist to meet that shift at scale, delivering measurable results such as lower energy intensity, greater flexibility and reliability, reduced operating costs, and structurally lower emissions. 

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you'll help turn that ambition into production reality: building the services, integrations, and cloud foundation that put our optimization and forecasting capabilities to work for customers every day. 

 

Your work will directly contribute to: 

  • Reducing and optimizing energy costs and emissions across Europe 

  • Enabling customers to participate in future energy flexibility and trading markets 

  • Optimizing multi-energy systems (heat, cold, electricity, storage, HVAC) 

  • Driving the transition toward autonomous, intelligent buildings and greenhouses 

  • Helping customers stay compliant with increasing regulatory pressure (e.g., CSRD) 

 

What You’ll Do 

Priva Digital Services & product engineering 

  • Design and build backend services that process data and execute optimization logic for products across Neo Heat, Neo Light, Neo Building, and Neo Smart 

  • Contribute to user-facing Priva Digital Services features end-to-end, including front-end work where it's the fastest path to shipping value 

  • Build and maintain APIs for internal and external integration 

Optimization & forecasting integration 

  • Implement and integrate optimization and forecasting logic into scalable, production-ready systems. You bring these models into production; you don't develop new optimization theory 

  • Work on data processing pipelines, scheduling logic, and system orchestration 

Cloud infrastructure & DevOps 

  • Own and improve cloud infrastructure (Azure) that supports scalability across Energy Solutions teams 

  • Strengthen CI/CD, monitoring, and deployment practices so systems are reliable, performant, and maintainable in real-world operation 

  • Collaborate with product, domain experts, and other engineers across teams to deliver end-to-end solutions 

  • Contribute to technical design decisions within your domain, and participate in the full software lifecycle: ideation → design → development → testing → deployment → monitoring 

 

What you will NOT do 

  • This is not a research or modelling role. You implement and integrate optimization and forecasting models rather than developing new theory 

  • You are not expected to be a dedicated front-end specialist or a dedicated DevOps specialist. The role spans these areas by design, so depth in every direction isn't the bar 


  • A bachelor's degree in an IT-related field 

  • Around 5 years of experience in a software engineering role, with demonstrated range across at least two of the following: backend/production systems, cloud infrastructure, front-end, or optimization integration. Versatility across these areas matters more here than deep tenure in a single one 

  • You've taken systems into production and kept them running, and can show or talk us through examples (work projects, open source, side projects) 

  • Experience with one or more of the following is a significant advantage: Python, Azure, Docker, Kubernetes/CI-CD tooling, SQL, KQL, Linux, and front-end frameworks (e.g., React/TypeScript) 

  • You are based in the Netherlands and are available to be in the office two to three days per week  

  • Strong problem-solving skills and a willingness to work with complex, unfamiliar systems 

  • A passion for creating customer value through high-quality engineering 

  • Curiosity, ownership, craftsmanship, and the drive to keep learning 

  • Good communication skills, able to explain trade-offs clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders 

  • A good vibe: you bring energy to the team and make collaboration genuinely enjoyable, not just effective 

 

What We Offer You 

💶 Excellent remuneration, competitive and aligned with experience 

🌴 30 days holiday per year, with the option to buy 5 extra at half price  

🏦 Excellent pension contribution  

🎓 €1,000 education budget per year  

⏰ Flexible working hours, and location.  

🍱 On-site canteen (e.g., poke bowl for €2)  

🏋️ Free onsite gym- with personal trainer.  

🎉 A vibrant, open culture where you can be yourself  

🌿 Human- and values-driven work, not corporate bureaucracy  

🍻 Twice-weekly drinks on Thursdays and Fridays

title: Security Architect
description:
Are you a security specialist in the OT space looking to expand your expertise into cloud solutions? Are you a cloud security champion passionate about bringing your expertise into OT/IoT space? At Priva Product Development Organisation we are looking for the Security Architect who will shape the security of our products.  

  

Security Architect in Priva Product Development – Why this role matters 

At Priva, we develop hardware products and software services for horticulture and building automation. Seeing the importance of our products for our customers, we recognize the need to continuously keep these secure in the ever evolving, fast-paced world. The security requirements in our landscape span four different areas: 

  1. Physical/embedded device security. 

  1. OT (operational technology) network security. 

  1. OT network to Priva-hosted cloud services communications. 

  1. Priva's hybrid on-prem/multi-cloud platform applications security, including applications, infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines.  

What makes this role truly unique is that our products contain long-lived hardware components that our customers run for years. Engineering future-proofed security solutions and maintaining a security posture at existing sites across all these areas having wide range of varying implementations and security needs creates a great challenge and a great fun. 

As part of the architecture team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of Priva's portfolio offered on the global market. You define security standards, security practices and security designs for our products that are used in tens of thousands of buildings and greenhouses. You work across product, engineering, and operations teams to ensure security controls and adhered to, implemented and tested as you have designed these. That’s real impact. 

What you will be doing 

As a Security Architect, you have a very simple mission: you see to it that Priva's hardware products and software (cloud) services are secured against known and emergent threats in lines with the industry standards and practices. You build upon your strong background in securing device/OT networks, cloud applications, and engraining the security practices in the daily work of Agile teams to achieve consistent security posture across all Priva products, designs, and customer deployments. 

 As a security architect, you are trusted counterpart of Priva Security, Quality, and Compliance officer to define, review, and execute controls arising from ISO9001 and ISO27001 standards and internal initiatives. You are responsible for presenting the necessary evidence of Priva’s compliance with these controls to the auditors. 

  • Security standards, policies, and design patterns library

title: Reliability Engineer
description:
Make Your Mark as a Reliability Engineer at Storio group

About the role.

We are looking for a Reliability Engineer to join our production team and help optimize our machinery operations. In this role, you will analyze the lifecycle of our equipment, evaluate how we manage asset maintenance, and prevent potential downtime before it happens. You will work closely with operational teams to keep our production running safely and smoothly across our plant.

When failures do occur, you will advise the team on how to respond quickly and effectively. You will use data and engineering risk methodologies to develop preventive maintenance strategies, establish inspection criteria, and protect our business from performance losses. Your work directly impacts our operational efficiency and the continuous delivery of personalized products to our customers.



How you embrace curiosity daily.

  • Analyze statistical data, performance losses, and cost drivers to predict equipment failures and uncover improvement opportunities.

  • Facilitate root cause analysis using techniques like FMEA, Fault Tree Analysis, and PHA for complex machinery issues.

  • Test new ideas and support machine trials to optimize process performance and material changes.

  • Review preventive maintenance programs and recommend technical updates to increase machinery availability.

  • Assess the technical feasibility of proposed changes from procurement and operational teams.

  • Explore innovative ways to streamline maintenance approaches while cutting overall operational costs.



How you make your mark.

  • Maximize equipment availability and reliability while lowering maintenance costs across the plant.

  • Develop effective maintenance strategies and clear standard operating procedures for autonomous maintenance.

  • Lead cross-functional improvement teams to solve persistent technical problems and boost site productivity.

  • Support capital investment projects to ensure new equipment meets strict maintainability standards and spare part requirements.

  • Conduct risk assessments to maintain full compliance with statutory inspection requirements, safety guidelines, and product quality standards.



What you bring to the team.

  • Strong experience as a reliability engineer or production specialist in a manufacturing environment.

  • Deep knowledge of reliability engineering techniques including FMEA, FTA, PHA, and criticality analysis.

  • Proven ability to facilitate root cause analysis and resolve complex technical equipment failures.

  • Practical background in developing preventive maintenance strategies, SOPs, and machine inspection criteria.

  • Hands-on experience supporting new machine installations, engineering trials, and capital projects.

  • Strong communication skills to guide production teams and collaborate on safety and quality standards.



What sets you apart.

  • Experience applying maintainability analysis within high-volume automated production settings.

  • Degree or formal qualification in Mechanical, Electrical, or Reliability Engineering.

title: Chief Information Security Officer
description:
Make security the reason people trust Ockto

Own security at the platform people use to share their most personal data

Every day, people use Ockto to share their identity, income, assets and bank data: when they apply for a mortgage, rent a home or take out a lease. Banks and other large organisations choose Ockto partly because of the level of assurance we offer around that data. At Ockto, security is not a support function. It is part of the product and organisational culture.

As our CISO, you make sure it stays that way as we grow. Part of that growth is adopting an AI driven operating model with strong guardrails. You own Ockto's security programme, from risk and controls to incidents, suppliers and audits. You set the standard, check that it is met, and make security measurable in a way that the whole organisation (and specifically our engineers and spec leads), clients, auditors and regulators all recognise. You do this with a real mandate and short lines to the people who decide.

What you'll do

You own the information security programme of a supervised financial company and make it work in daily practice, not just on paper. As CISO, you:

  • Own Ockto's ISMS and security policy framework, and keep our ISO 27001 certification (held since 2017) and our SOC 2 assurance current and credible.

  • Translate the risk appetite set by management into a security strategy, an annual plan and clear standards that teams can build to.

  • Keep Ockto ahead of what's coming. You track developments such as eIDAS2 and the EU Digital Identity Wallet, NIS2, the Cyber Resilience Act and the AI Act, assess what they mean for Ockto and our clients, and translate them into our security strategy and standards in time.

  • Verify and challenge. Our engineering teams operate the technical controls; you check that they work and that findings get fixed. You approve risk acceptance for serious vulnerabilities and commission penetration tests. All control owners are challenged and prepared to show evidence and reproduce controls.

  • Lead the response to security and privacy incidents, approve notifications to regulators, and make sure root causes lead to structural fixes.

  • Manage security risk in our supply chain, from onboarding new suppliers to the annual review of critical ones, in line with DORA.

  • Make sure our continuity and recovery arrangements are tested and hold up, together with Engineering.

  • Make security measurable. We judge it by how quickly and how structurally we resolve what we find, not by counting incidents.

  • Represent Ockto's security towards clients, auditors and supervisors: from a bank's due diligence questionnaire to our external audits and contact with DNB and AFM.

  • Build a security-aware culture with an awareness programme people actually remember.

Who you work with

You report to our Product & Trust Director, who sets Ockto's trust framework and risk appetite. Within that framework, the security strategy and its execution are yours. On security matters you also have a direct line to our CEO, and you are involved early in the product and architecture decisions that shape our risk. Our Information Security Officer is part of your team and runs day-to-day control monitoring with you.

You also work closely with our Engineering Director and the value stream teams that build and run the Ockto platform. They operate the technical controls as the first line; you set the requirements, verify and challenge as the second.

Outside Ockto, you work with the security, risk and procurement teams of our clients and with our external auditors. For audits you are the first line of planning, execution and communication with the auditor(s). Together with the Product & Trust Director, you are Ockto's security contact for DNB and AFM.


What you bring

You combine depth in security with the judgement to apply it pragmatically in a scale-up. We're looking for someone who:

•     Has 8+ years of experience in information security, including at least 3 years leading a security function as CISO, Head of Security or similar.

•     Has run an ISMS end to end and taken an organisation through ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II audits.

•     Knows regulated financial services and works comfortably with DORA, PSD2, GDPR and supervision by DNB or AFM.

•     Has solid grounding in cloud security, preferably AWS, and enough technical understanding to challenge engineers and judge designs.

•     Thinks in risk: turns threats into priorities, and weighs security against cost and delivery speed.

•     Communicates clearly at every level, from the management team and auditors to developers and a client's security officer.

•     Is independent and principled: comfortable saying no, and good at finding the route to yes.

•     Speaks and writes English fluently; Dutch is a strong advantage.

Will be a plus:

•     CISSP, CISM, CCSP or ISO 27001 Lead Auditor or Lead Implementer certification.

•     Experience with privacy governance and DPIAs.

•     Experience leading incident response, including notification to regulators.

•     Experience with third-party risk management and assurance reporting such as ISAE 3402 or ISAE 3000.

•     Familiarity with digital identity, eIDAS2 and EU digital identity wallets.

•     Experience governing the safe use of AI tooling in a data-sensitive environment.

What you get

You get a role with real influence on how far clients, supervisors and consumers can trust Ockto.

•     Ownership of security at a company where assurance is one of the reasons clients choose us.

•     A real mandate: a direct line to the CEO on security matters, a voice early in product and architecture decisions, and the final word on accepting serious security risk.

•     Influence on what we build next, as Ockto grows into new markets and propositions.

•     Short lines and room to shape the security function the way it should work.

•     Experienced colleagues across product, engineering and compliance.

Ockto also offers:

•     A good salary: between €5500,- and €6800,- per month, depending on experience

•     Room and budget for personal and professional development

•     A MacBook Pro and smartphone of choice

•     Phone and travel allowance

•     Great home and remote working facilities

•     Lunch fee

•     Plenty of activities, including our annual ski trip, a 1.5-day team offsite, drinks and team outings

You'll join a team that values diversity and collaboration, in a friendly, ambitious and innovative atmosphere.


About Ockto

Ockto is the leading platform for future-proof wallet services. For more than ten years we have been taking the friction out of sharing, verifying and enriching personal data, so that organisations and people can trust each other faster, based on the right information. title: Afstudeerstage Marketing
description:
Afstudeeropdracht: Ontwerp een innovatief product voor de groei van 12Build!

Over 12Build

12Build is een SaaS-platform dat bouwbedrijven met elkaar verbindt en zo de samenwerking in de bouw makkelijker en transparanter maakt. We bestaan bijna twintig jaar en groeien nog steeds hard. We hebben meer dan 90 collega’s op kantoren in Nijverdal en Zwolle. Ons platform wordt dagelijks gebruikt in de Benelux, Duitsland en Denemarken, en we willen heel Europa veroveren. Met zo’n snelle groei liggen er veel vragen klaar waar nog niemand goed antwoord op heeft. Daar zoeken we jou voor.

De opdracht

We geven je geen dichtgetimmerde opdracht. Je gaat samen met Ed, je begeleider vanuit 12Build, uitzoeken welke uitdaging het beste past bij jouw opleiding en interesses. Het eindresultaat ligt wel vast: je levert een innovatief product op dat 12Build echt kan gebruiken. Dat kan een concept zijn, een tool, een strategie, een prototype of een nieuw proces, zolang het werkt en waarde oplevert.

Ontwerpvraag (startpunt):

Welk innovatief product kan 12Build ontwikkelen om sneller en slimmer te groeien in de internationale markt, en hoe ziet dat product eruit Samen maak je deze vraag in de eerste weken concreet. Mogelijke richtingen:

• AI en kennisdeling: hoe zetten we AI in om klanten en gebruikers te helpen, bijvoorbeeld met cursussen of leercontent in de 12Build Academy?.

• Groei en leadgeneratie: hoe trekken we meer nieuwe klanten aan en volgen we leads slimmer op, bijvoorbeeld met lead scoring of automatisering?.

• Self-service: hoe zorgen we dat gebruikers zelf de weg vinden op het platform en sneller een betalend account nemen?.

• Internationale groei: hoe pakken we een nieuwe markt aan en wat werkt in Nederland wel of juist niet in Duitsland of Denemarken?.

• Klantbeleving en data: hoe halen we meer uit klantdata, reviews en feedback om onze dienstverlening te verbeteren?.

• Jouw eigen idee: zie je een kans die hier niet tussen staat? Dan horen we dat graag..

Wat lever je op?

• Een onderzoek naar het probleem en de kansen, met input van collega’s, klanten of de markt;.

• Een uitgewerkt en getest product, concept of prototype;.

• Een advies over hoe 12Build het product kan invoeren, zodat het na je stage gewoon verder gebruikt wordt..

Maud over haar stage bij 12Build:

“12Build is voor mij een plek waar ik mezelf kan en mag ontwikkelen. Ik voel me vanaf het eerste moment welkom in een super leuk team. Er is fijne begeleiding, ruimte om vragen te stellen en feedback te geven/ontvangen. De kernwaarden Happiness, Openness en Drive voel je als je hier binnen stapt.”

Wie is 12Build?
12Build in het kort: Met een flinke portie Drive, Happiness en Openness bouwen wij aan een transparante bouwbranche. Wij zijn een SaaS platform dat bouwbedrijven verbindt en zo de samenwerking bevordert. We bestaan al bijna twintig jaar en groeien nog steeds. Inmiddels zijn we met meer dan 90 collega’s, verdeeld over 2 kantoren (Nijverdal en Zwolle). Een groot deel van de bouwwereld in de Benelux, Duitsland en Denemarken werkt al op ons platform en gebruikt onze software op dagelijkse basis. En we hebben de ambitie om heel Europa te veroveren.


Wie zoeken we?

• Een hbo- of wo-student die gaat afstuderen in bijvoorbeeld marketing, bedrijfskunde, commerciële economie, business innovation, communicatie, AI of een vergelijkbare studie;.

• Iemand die zelf ideeën aandraagt en het leuk vindt om iets nieuws neer te zetten;.

• Iemand die beschikbaar is vanaf februari 2027, voor de duur van je afstudeerperiode;.

• Iemand die Nederlands spreekt. Duits of Engels is een pluspunt..

Wat bieden we?

• Een stagevergoeding;.

• Een eigen opdracht met echte impact in een internationaal en snelgroeiend bedrijf;.

• Begeleiding door een ervaren collega en een team van zeven marketeers;.

• Een platte organisatie waarin jouw ideeën gehoord worden;.

• Thuis en op kantoor werken, een relaxruimte met pooltafel, tafeltennis en FIFA, en geregeld uitjes en teamdagen..

Interesse?

Laat in je reactie weten welke richting je aanspreekt, of welk eigen idee je hebt. Een paar zinnen is genoeg, het hoeft geen uitgewerkt plan te zijn. Voor vragen kun je terecht bij Niels (Recruiter), via

title: Afstuderen: Integratie van machine data voor resourceplanning
description:
WAT GA JE DOEN?

Bij onze internationale klanten wordt voor de dagelijkse productie gebruikgemaakt van verschillende LogicSteel software applicaties. LogicSteel MRP ondersteunt hierbij operationele processen, zoals het plannen van productie, het beheren van projecten, inkooporders en het aansturen van medewerkers. Daarnaast zijn er systemen zoals Insights die machine- en prestatiegegevens inzichtelijk maken. Doordat informatie verdeeld is over meerdere applicaties, ontbreekt vaak één centraal overzicht voor resourceplanning en capaciteitsbeslissingen.

Tijdens deze afstudeeropdracht onderzoek je hoe relevante gegevens uit deze systemen beter gecombineerd en gepresenteerd kunnen worden, zodat gebruikers sneller de juiste inzichten hebben voor het plannen van mensen, machines en productiecapaciteit.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • Het analyseren van het huidige resourceallocatieproces en de rol van machine- en productiegegevens hierin;

  • Het voeren van interviews met gebruikers om hun doelen, behoeften en knelpunten in kaart te brengen;

  • Het onderzoeken welke data uit Insights en MRP relevant is voor besluitvorming;

  • Het analyseren van gebruikersstromen, beschikbare data en bestaande schermen;

  • Het ontwikkelen van wireframes, gebruikersflows en ontwerpconcepten;

  • Het valideren en verbeteren van ontwerpen door middel van feedbacksessies met gebruikers en stakeholders;

  • Het vertalen van gebruikersbehoeften naar functionele requirements;

  • Het opstellen van een advies voor de integratie en presentatie van machinegegevens over verschillende platformen.

Het eindresultaat is een onderbouwd ontwerp- en implementatievoorstel waarmee gebruikers sneller en beter onderbouwde beslissingen kunnen nemen op het gebied van resourceplanning en machinebezetting.


WIJ VRAGEN

  • HBO- of WO-opleiding in de richting van UI/UX Design, Human Computer Interaction, Interaction Technology of vergelijkbaar.

WIJ BIEDEN

  • Een vergoeding: €600,- per maand;

  • Reiskostenvergoeding: zodat jij geen onnodige kosten maakt;

  • Apparatuur en materialen: bijvoorbeeld een laptop, speciaal gereedschap of software;

  • Ervaren coach: goede begeleiding is belangrijk en dus krijg je een vaste coach om je te ondersteunen;

  • Ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

Over Voortman

Wat in 1968 begon in een kippenschuur in Rijssen, is uitgegroeid tot wereldspeler in CNC-staalbewerkingsmachines. Met een team van meer dan 750 collega’s wereldwijd ontwikkelen en bouwen we niet alleen high-end machines, maar ook slimme software en service waarop klanten kunnen vertrouwen. Deze 3 krachtige bouwstenen maken ons Twentse, internationale familiebedrijf uniek.

title: Senior Front-End Engineer (React) - Personalization
Commercial Legal Counsel, EMEA
description:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

About the team

The Legal team at Airwallex is a collaborative group of legal minds and risk management experts. We're passionate about safeguarding Airwallex's operations, fostering a culture of compliance and ethical conduct, and ensuring we navigate the global financial landscape with integrity. We provide expert guidance and support to all areas of the business, proactively identifying, mitigating, and managing legal and financial risks.

What you’ll do

Airwallex is looking for an experienced (Senior) Counsel to support our fast growing commercial legal team across EMEA. You will support a complex set of fintech products that will challenge your problem solving and critical thinking skills. You will support a wide variety of commercial legal matters supporting Airwallex’s growing Sales team, and help us build for scale in several EMEA markets, ranging from Germany, Israel, France, the Netherlands to the UK. This is a strategic position and you will be a key advisor to Airwallex’s EMEA go-to-market Commercial team.

This position is based in Amsterdam, the Netherlands.

Responsibilities:

  • Drive complex deals. Personally lead negotiations on high-stakes enterprise commercial and strategic partnership deals across EMEA (with a strong emphasis on our UK, NL, and IL business), many with significant cross-border elements.

  • Build for scale. Develop and implement an innovative strategy for delivering efficient and effective commercial legal support. Drive the creation and maintenance of scalable templates, playbooks, and processes to support our rapidly growing business.

  • Be a strategic partner. Act as a key advisor to our dynamic, globally distributed commercial leadership. Partner with the Commercial team to scale our go-to-market efforts and advance multi-product and multi-jurisdictional deal strategies.

  • Enhance Efficiency. Learn from our data and operations teams to leverage technology, automation, and data-driven insights to increase the efficiency and impact of the Commercial Legal function.

  • Collaborate Globally. Work closely and effectively with Airwallex’s global legal, compliance, and risk teams on deals and projects that involve multiple jurisdictions

  • Contribute to Culture. Make a positive contribution to the culture of the Airwallex legal team, the EMEA team, and the company as a whole.

Who you are

We're looking for people who meet the minimum qualifications for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

Must-Haves:

  • You bring 5-8 years of legal experience, with experience in private practice at a top law firm. Additional in-house experience at a fintech is strongly preferred.

  • Excellent communication, drafting, negotiation, and writing skills.

  • The ability to explain complex legal concepts to various non-legal audiences, and the ability to manage and prioritize multiple projects and deals.

  • High motivation and the ability to operate independently and pivot quickly within a fast-paced, rapidly changing environment.

  • A learner’s mentality: you are consistently looking to take on new and diverse challenges and expand your knowledge beyond your current areas of expertise.

  • A collaborative and empathetic mindset, a good sense of humor, and a keen understanding of how to work effectively with colleagues from different teams and backgrounds.

  • Ability to translate complex legal and risk issues into clear, succinct, and actionable guidance.

  • High integrity, sound judgment, and an unflappable demeanor and collaborative style of working

Nice-to-Haves:

  • Experience at a fintech or in the banking industry or high-growth and/or globally distributed company.

  • Experience drafting and negotiating technology transactions, SaaS agreements, and other customer-facing services agreements.

  • French/German/Spanish language skills preferred

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.
